data.name: Roomballs
data.detailed_description:
Soccer meets air hockey with an incredible twist: fast-paced, chaotic robots inspired by your favorite pop culture icons.

Master curved shots, precision passes, turbo boosts, and clever teamwork in a game where skill, strategy, and quick thinking matter just as much as speed. Whether you're competing online, playing with friends on the couch, challenging bots, or conquering solo content, every match delivers intense action and unforgettable moments.

Step into the arena and prove you have what it takes to become a Roomballs champion!

KEY FEATURES

  • Up to 8 players in online matches

  • Friendly online lobbies and local couch mode

  • Country and global rankings

  • Up to 4 players in split-screen couch mode

  • Fast-paced gameplay featuring passes, curved shots, turbo boosts, and physical collisions

  • 300+ unique characters, skins, and customization items to collect

  • Earn Roombolts and valuable rewards by winning matches and completing challenges

  • 36 solo Cup Challenges featuring unique opponents and rewards

  • Academy mode designed to help new players master every mechanic

  • AI bots for solo play, practice, and filling matches

  • Multiple arenas with unique themes and atmospheres

  • Customizable Roomballs with tons of accessories and visual options

Roomballs isn't just about competition—it's about creating unforgettable moments with friends. Climb the rankings, unlock new rewards, master your skills, and experience the chaotic fun of robotic soccer like never before.

Easy to learn. Hard to master. Impossible to forget.

Generative AI tools were used in the creation of some music, localization, and artwork. The game does not generate AI content during gameplay.
